caption:
Your pipeline doesn't fail all at once.

It leaks one unanswered lead at a time, and most owners never audit it because there's no alarm when it happens.

Run this 4-question check every Friday:
1. What was your average response time this week?
2. Did any calls go unanswered with no follow-up text?
3. How many touches did a cold lead get before you stopped?
4. Did you message anyone from last month's no's?

Most service businesses miss the one-hour response window. Close that gap first and the rest of the pipeline follows.

Want Black Arrow to run this audit on your pipeline?
